description: Author reusable standard play maps for the top-down Advantage games and rebuild the Wizard vs. Zombie graveyard as the reference map.
deviation_notes: Nine typed StandardPlayMap layouts and nine composed PNGs shipped. Only Wizard vs. Zombie renders its authored map in-engine; the other eight cartridges keep their existing procedural layouts because each has bespoke motion and engine tests. Wiring those games to the maps is deferred to a follow-up. The in-crypt live enemy spawn is represented as a decor coffin; actual enemySpawns stay at the perimeter gates to preserve the 64 existing Wizard engine tests. check-types reports 53 pre-existing errors in untouched files; no error is in src/maps.

sprint.goal: Give every top-down Advantage game a reusable authored play map, and rebuild the Wizard vs. Zombie graveyard as the reference map.
